C1620.title: Hangzhou Internet Court Hears AI Face-Swap App Infringement of Portrait Rights Case
C1620.summary: Hangzhou Internet Court heard an AI face-swapping app portrait rights infringement case: the defendant Shanghai company operated an AI face-swapping app that used deep synthesis technology to create forged videos using plaintiff Lou portrait without consent. The court found the conduct infringed portrait rights and the judgment has taken effect. Claims about late 2022 timing, apology, and 5,000 yuan compensation should be supported by the judgment text or authoritative reports if retained.

references.title: How Should Portrait Rights Be Protected When Someone Else's Video Is Used as a Profitable AI Face-Swap Template?
